import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
def f(inp):
    import numpy as np
    g=np.array(inp); H,W=g.shape
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True)
    bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()])
    # divider color: color forming full rows/cols -> use most common non-bg color that makes full lines? 
    others=[v for v in vals if v!=bg]
    dc=None
    # find divider: color whose column is constant through or near full height
    for v in others:

        rowpos=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]==v]
        if colpos or rowpos: dc=v; break
    div=set(colpos)|set(rowpos)
    # regions: split by divider lines; collect cells whose color != bg and not divider, per region

    rbrs=[0]+[i+1 for i in rowpos]; cbrs=[0]+[j+1 for j in colpos]
    Rb=[list(range(rbrs[i],rbrs[i+1])) for i in range(len(rbrs)-1)]
    Cb=[list(range(cbrs[i],cbrs[i+1])) for i in range(len(cbrs)-1)]
    src=None; off=None
    for ri,rws in enumerate(Rb):
        for ci,cws in enumerate(Cb):
            cells=[(rr-rws[0],cc-cws[0],g[rr,cc]) for rr in rws for cc in cws if g[rr,cc]!=bg and g[rr,cc]!=dc]
            if cells: src=(ri,ci); off=(rws[0],cws[0]); pat=dict(cells)
    out=g.copy()
    for ri,rws in enumerate(Rb):
        for ci,cws in enumerate(Cb):
            if (ri,ci)!=src:
                for (dr,dc_,v) in pat.items():
                    r,c=off[0]+dr,off[1]+dc_
                    if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and g[r,c]!=dc: out[r,c]=v
    return [[int(x) for x in row] for row in out]
